name: stitch-design-taste
title_zh: 给 Google Stitch 立一份不许平庸的 U
tagline_zh: AI 生成的界面总是一眼就看出是 AI 做的：居中、圆角、紫蓝渐变、字体随便挑。
tagline_en: AI-built screens all look the same: centered, rounded, purple gradients, default fonts. This skill writes a.
desc_en: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.
why_zh: 它不生成界面，生成的是约束。把「高级感」拆成可执行的硬指标：字阶、色域、非对称栅格、常驻微动效。
why_en: It doesn't generate UI, it generates constraints. "Premium" becomes enforceable rules: type scale, calibrated color, asymmetric.
limit_zh: 只服务 Google Stitch，产物是一份 DESIGN.md 规范文件，不画界面也不出代码；换到 Figma。
limit_en: Stitch-only. Output is a DESIGN.md spec file, not screens or code. No hook into Figma, v0 or Cursor. The stricter the spec, the less freedom Stitch.
title_en: A DESIGN.md constitution that bans generic UI in Google.
